name: Ain't No Telling
summary: Anastasia at Stromgarde Keep will not discuss her superiors’ secret deal without a reason. You need something valuable enough to make her talk.

sections.title: A Reason to Talk
sections.body: At Stromgarde Keep, Anastasia refuses to share what her superiors are doing with a newcomer. She asks for something important or valuable before she will speak. You need to find something in the keep that convinces her to give details about the secret deal.

sections.title: The Bargain
sections.body: Anastasia reacts when you show her what you found. She agrees to tell you about the deal if you give it back to her.

faq.answer: Anastasia is the person who can give you details about her superiors’ secret deal.
Anastasia says she will not share her superiors’ dealings without a good reason.
Anastasia asks for something important or valuable before she will discuss the deal.

faq.q: Where do I look for something to convince her?
faq.answer: Anastasia asks you to find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince her.

attribution: In-game quest text: Ain't No Telling
